lyrics:
[Verse]
There's a way to be found
You don't need their permission
To begin what you do
Keep building your future
And keep being you
[Chorus]
So don't stop the hustle
Let the hard days pass
Make a little more room
For the dreams that last
You've got miles still to go
And your own path to choose
Hold on to your purpose
You've got nothing to lose
[Verse]
Yo
Don't stop the hustle
Don't ever quit
Society will change
But you'll stick with it
Never kill your dreams
Never let them sway you
You can make it and achieve
Never let them play you
This life is yours
Don't let them dissuade you
You don't owe your future
To the box that they gave you
[Verse]
Don't let grandpa
Still confused by his phone
Tell you using AI
Means your mind ain't your own
Says it's killing creativity
Well, that's a hell of a line
He's been fighting with his printer
Since 2009
Let him find the paper
You can find the beat
Put a little of your life
Into something on repeat
If it isn't what you wanted
Then you give it another go
You've got something in your head
That nobody else can know
[Bridge]
You can take a little break
You can have a little doubt
You don't have to have it figured
Just to start figuring it out
Make something that you love
Even if it doesn't pay
You don't need a million people
To believe in it today
[Final Chorus]
So don't stop the hustle
Let the hard days pass
Make a little more room
For the dreams that last
You've got miles still to go
And your own path to choose
Hold on to your purpose
You've got nothing to lose
[Outro]
Keep building your future
And keep being you
They don't have to get it
For you to see it through
Grandpa got it printing
So there's hope for him too
